item.text: All 60 questions use the same wording and return fields, so one query shape fits them all. I’m checking that it gives CR-pack membership priority, returns no rows for an explicit whole-document closure, and otherwise returns `INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS`.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re

with open('packet.json', encoding='utf-8') as source:
    packet = json.load(source)

query_shape = \"\"\"WITH '__TDOC__' AS target
OPTIONAL MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(pack:CRPack)
WHERE (cr:Tdoc OR cr:CR) AND cr.tdocNumber = target
WITH target, collect(DISTINCT pack) AS packs
OPTIONAL MATCH (resolution:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION|DISPOSITION_OF]-(disposition:DecisionDisposition),
               (resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WHERE (disposition.targetTdocNumber = target
       OR (disposition)-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(:Tdoc {tdocNumber: target}))
  AND toLower(replace(replace(replace(trim(coalesce(resolution.resolutionScope, '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''))
      IN ['document', 'wholedocument', 'fulldocument', 'entiredocument', 'documentlevel', 'documentwide', 'tdoc', 'wholetdoc', 'fulltdoc', 'entiretdoc', 'tdoclevel']
  AND toLower(replace(replace(replace(trim(coalesce(disposition.dispositionCode, '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''))
      IN ['withdrawn', 'nottreated', 'notpursued', 'rejected', 'notagreed']
  AND toLower(replace(replace(replace(trim(coalesce(meeting.workingGroup, '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''))
      IN ['ran3', 'r3', 'tsgran3', 'ranwg3', 'tsgranwg3', '3gpptsgran3', '3gpptsgranwg3']
WITH packs, count(DISTINCT disposition) AS closure_count
UNWIND CASE
         WHEN size(packs) > 0 THEN packs
         WHEN closure_count > 0 THEN []
         ELSE [{crPackId: 'INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS', tsgMeeting: 'INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS'}]
       END AS result
RETURN DISTINCT result.crPackId AS cr_pack, result.tsgMeeting AS tsg_meeting\"\"\"

items = packet['items']
assert len(items) == 60
assert len({item['id'] for item in items}) == 60
question_shapes = set()
rows = []
for item in items:
    assert item['fields'] == ['cr_pack', 'tsg_meeting']
    match = re.search(r'(R3-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.]+)\\)', item['question'])
    assert match, item['id']
    question_shapes.add(item['question'][:match.start()] + '__TARGET__' + item['question'][match.end():])
    query = query_shape.replace('__TDOC__', match.group(1))
    assert query.endswith('RETURN DISTINCT result.crPackId AS cr_pack, result.tsgMeeting AS tsg_meeting')
    rows.append({'id': item['id'], 'cypher': query})
assert len(question_shapes) == 1
assert len({re.sub(r'R3-\\d+', '__TDOC__', row['cypher']) for row in rows}) == 1
serialized = ''.join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + '\\n' for row in rows)
assert len(serialized.splitlines()) == 60
assert all(set(json.loads(line)) == {'id', 'cypher'} for line in serialized.splitlines())
with open('queries.jsonl', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as destination:
    destination.write(serialized)
print('Queries written: 60; distinct query shapes: 1; question wording ambiguities: none. Queries were not executed.')
PY"
